Context: Medical claims requiring opinion of specialists

3. If approval of Directorate or Ministry is involved, the Additional Directors shall submit only e-file with self-contained note and recommen dation, enclosing only relevant scanned documents. Care shall be taken not to reject medical claims of pensioner CGHS beneficiaries on minor technical objections if they fall under procedural lapses, which can be condoned.  
- OM, dated 14-5-2018.
